card.name: Gaps before numbers and range words
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number or second value in a list, range or statistic, such as after 'every', 'HR 1.62,' or 'grey to'. It also appears on 'to' in color ranges.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space or digit position just before a figure in doses, lab values or statistics.
modes.example: mg/10,000 units every 2 weeks or 1,200 mg/20,000 units every<< >>4 weeks. (2.3)

modes.label: 'to' in a range
modes.description: The word 'to' linking two colors or values in a range, in animal descriptions.
modes.example: Brown<< to>> pale gray above, with pure white unders

modes.label: Confidence interval start
modes.description: The space after a comma in a hazard ratio before the interval.

card.writes: It suppresses odd rare tokens and slightly lowers 'overall' words, so it adds no clear effect.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before a number or second value in a range, dose or statistic.
